name: parse_missing_patch_is_zero
spec_sentence: The result is the three integers; a missing PATCH counts as 0 ("v0.2" → [0, 2, 0], "v1.4.3" → [1, 4, 3]).

name: parse_full_three_part_version
spec_sentence: Valid versions are exactly "v" followed by MAJOR.MINOR or MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, each part a non-negative decimal integer written without leading zeros ("0" itself is fine, "01" is not).

name: parse_multi_digit_minor
spec_sentence: The result is the three integers; a missing PATCH counts as 0 ("v0.2" → [0, 2, 0], "v1.4.3" → [1, 4, 3]).

name: parse_uppercase_v_rejected
spec_sentence: Anything else gives null: no leading lowercase "v" (also "V0.2"), only one part ("v1"), four or more parts, empty parts, signs, letters or suffixes ("v0.2-beta", "v0.2rc1"), surrounding whitespace, the empty string, a non-string value.

name: parse_leading_zero_rejected
spec_sentence: Valid versions are exactly "v" followed by MAJOR.MINOR or MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, each part a non-negative decimal integer written without leading zeros ("0" itself is fine, "01" is not).

name: parse_suffix_rejected
spec_sentence: Anything else gives null: no leading lowercase "v" (also "V0.2"), only one part ("v1"), four or more parts, empty parts, signs, letters or suffixes ("v0.2-beta", "v0.2rc1"), surrounding whitespace, the empty string, a non-string value.

name: parse_non_string_rejected
spec_sentence: Anything else gives null: no leading lowercase "v" (also "V0.2"), only one part ("v1"), four or more parts, empty parts, signs, letters or suffixes ("v0.2-beta", "v0.2rc1"), surrounding whitespace, the empty string, a non-string value.

name: release_message_exact_format
spec_sentence: Exactly "auto-job-search-agent " + version + " (public export)", e.g. "auto-job-search-agent v0.2 (public export)".

name: preflight_clean_new_version_passes
spec_sentence: An empty list means the release may go ahead. With no version tags at all, any valid version is newer.

name: preflight_bad_version_only
spec_sentence: 1. "bad_version" — version is not valid for parse_version.

name: preflight_bad_version_no_history_dirty_behind
spec_sentence: Codes, always in this order when several apply: 1. "bad_version" … 2. "no_history" … 3. "not_main" … 4. "dirty" … 5. "behind" …

name: preflight_no_history_suppresses_not_main
spec_sentence: 2. "no_history" — has_commits is false. When this applies, "not_main" is NOT reported.

name: preflight_not_main_branch
spec_sentence: 3. "not_main" — has_commits is true and branch is not exactly "main".

name: preflight_dirty_and_behind
spec_sentence: 4. "dirty" — dirty is true. 5. "behind" — behind is greater than 0.

name: preflight_tag_exists_suppresses_not_newer
spec_sentence: 6. "tag_exists" — the version is valid and the exact same string is already in tags. … "tag_exists" and "not_newer" are never both reported.

name: preflight_not_newer_numeric_compare_v010_gt_v09
spec_sentence: 7. "not_newer" — the version is valid, not already a tag, and some tag that is a valid version is greater than or equal to it (compare [major, minor, patch] numerically, so v0.10 > v0.9, and v0.2 equals v0.2.0).

name: preflight_not_newer_equal_v020_tag
spec_sentence: 7. "not_newer" — the version is valid, not already a tag, and some tag that is a valid version is greater than or equal to it (compare [major, minor, patch] numerically, so v0.10 > v0.9, and v0.2 equals v0.2.0).

name: preflight_non_version_tags_ignored
spec_sentence: Tags that are not valid versions are ignored.

name: preflight_no_version_tags_at_all_passes
spec_sentence: With no version tags at all, any valid version is newer.

name: preflight_full_ordering_not_main_dirty_behind_tag_exists
spec_sentence: Codes, always in this order when several apply: 1. "bad_version" … 2. "no_history" … 3. "not_main" … 4. "dirty" … 5. "behind" … 6. "tag_exists" … 7. "not_newer" …

name: stale_paths_basic_removal
spec_sentence: Returns, sorted ascending and without duplicates, every clone path that is not in exported — the files to delete before copying the export in.

name: stale_paths_git_paths_never_returned
spec_sentence: Never returns ".git" or anything starting with ".git/" (but ".github/…" and ".gitignore" are ordinary files).

name: stale_paths_github_and_gitignore_are_ordinary_sorted
spec_sentence: Never returns ".git" or anything starting with ".git/" (but ".github/…" and ".gitignore" are ordinary files).

name: stale_paths_deduplicates
spec_sentence: Returns, sorted ascending and without duplicates, every clone path that is not in exported — the files to delete before copying the export in.

name: stale_paths_backslash_counts_as_slash
spec_sentence: clone_tracked: paths tracked in the clone; exported: paths in the new export (both repo-relative, "/" separated; a "\" in a path counts as "/").

name: stale_paths_empty_string_ignored
spec_sentence: Empty strings in clone_tracked are ignored.

name: stale_paths_nothing_stale
